def zero_pad_number(n, width):
    neg = n < 0
    n = abs(n)
    digits = []
    if n == 0:
        digits.append('0')
    while n > 0:
        digits.append(str(n % 10))
        n //= 10
    body = ''.join(reversed(digits))
    total = width - (1 if neg else 0)
    while len(body) < total:
        body = '0' + body
    return ('-' if neg else '') + body
